entities.name: Failed Response Header
entities.description: Top level wrapper Data Element returned when calling any MUPIX request URL fails to return expected results. Requested Data Elements or related error messages are contained within this wrapper.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: A list of Message Data Elements. One or more Messages will be present when the status is zero

fields.name: status
fields.description: 0 = failed; When the status is zero the data property will be empty and one or more messages will be present within the messages element. For example zero will be returned when parameter values have failed validation.
